i wish you a happy happy birthday, filled with love, sunshine,
lots of cake and potatoes! Thank you for always blessing us
with amazing comfy streams and wonderful stunning beautiful
art! You are an absolute cutie and amazing person who build
this amazing community and i'm sure everybody around you is
happy that you are a part of this world and their life♥ May
the next 365 days be filled with love, only good art days
and lots of luck for you!
Hope you are having an amazing day, lot of cake, love and fun.
You're an amazing person and you deserve every wonderful thing
that's coming or already arrived today.
Every single piece of art you do shows just how passionate you
are about art. It's amazing how you create every single unique
oc, I was able to create only one and even that I needed help
I went down memory lane and do you know when and what was the first
message that was sent between us? I mean probably not since I had to
check it myself as well, but guess what, it was a meme I made and
wanted to share with you back in 2022.
Can you believe it? 2022, holy moly! And looking back I did a lot
of memes XD. But I also saw what you went through and how you overcame
it. And one thing I noticed, and I just want to point it out, I hope
As you can see people didn't forget you and this game, these messages,
these amazing drawings are proof of that and I hope you never forget that.
I know I have not been that much on your streams last months but from what
I appear and from the times I lurk in the shadows I am happy
that you have such an amazing community and seeing you happy makes me happy as well.
And as a last part of going down the memory lane I would like to share an art I made
for your birthday the same year I got to know you.
I hope you like our gift for you and all the other gifts you received
from all of us! I'm certain I by far am not only speaking for myself
but for the whole community that because of you I'm always cheering up
for tuesdays, thursdays and saturdays, to be able to enjoy your streams
and the whole community you created. It was especially fun to create all
those maps for the game but also super interesting to do things like creating
items such as the map, the hints or the necklace and ear ring that can be combined.
(Of course not to take away the help of all the others, Tschang for
example in case of the respective item sprites.)
And when I got to drawing something for you to put in this room I
realized that I so far have never drawn you in your "new" outfit.
(which is a bit ironic considering you now use it for longer than the
one I drew you in for your DTIYS challenge) But now I can say I'm glad
I did because it has been quite fun, even though I set out for a bit
more of a simplified approach at places.
(Totally not due to time constraints, nono I definitely did not
finish this 2 days before the final test release.)
You are very tall and badass and don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
In all seriousness, happy birthday Oko. May your birthday be filled
with nothing but joy and happyness. Your wondefull streams, incredible
OCs and gorgeous illustrations have left me struck in awe more times than
I can count and I cannot wait to see what incredible Artworks and storys
your future holds. Thank you for being awesome.
Happy birthday u silly little badass fry munching goober ♥
I hope you have a day filled with laughter and joy,
just as you bring it to so many others!
Time is so short, a flash and another year has gone by.
And what a year it has been.
Ups and downs, the serious and the derp, the laughs and the lows.
All of it worth it because of my friendship with you.
Thank you for all the wonderful memories and moments we share,
and I look forward to the millions more we shall make in the bright future together.
I also hope you enjoy the package I sent you :3
Here's to you, you wonderful bitch!
